coachEvents.text: Coast bar — one, empty, empty, empty, straight time, eight bars. One touch, three empty slots. Move, breathe, stay ready.
Pump: crosses only, double-time — ten bars. Pump the crosses in a short burst. Keep the shoulder behind them.
Coast bar — one, empty, two, empty, straight time, fourteen bars. One, empty, two, empty. Let the coast stay active.
Long set: body jabs only, time-and-a-half — twenty bars. Pump the body jabs. Small level change, fast return.

notes: Pump & Coast pump / coast blocks are DELIBERATELY coach-silent — sustained + coast runtime consumers not yet wired. silentByDesign is TBD until the manifest generator learns to detect those block spans (Slice 6).
